title: 听力挑战 · 复习经验分享

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: In cloze tests, I read the whole passage first because the context determines the missing words.
rounds.lineCn: 做完形填空时,我先读全文,因为上下文决定空格处的单词。

grammar.name: 完形填空:先读后填
grammar.note: 先通读全文把握语境,再根据上下文逻辑选词,这是完形解题核心策略。

options.text: He reads the whole passage first to understand the context.
options.feedback: 他先通读全文,依据语境确定答案。

options.text: He fills the blanks without reading the passage first.
options.feedback: 他的做法是先读全文,并非直接填词。

options.text: He reads only the sentences that contain blanks.
options.feedback: 他只读含空格句子,而原文强调先读全文。

rounds.speaker: 学长
rounds.line: For the new question type, identifying logical connectors helps me choose the correct order of paragraphs.
rounds.lineCn: 做新题型时,识别逻辑连接词能帮我排出正确的段落顺序。

grammar.name: 新题型解题技巧
grammar.note: 动名词 identifying 作主语;逻辑连接词是排序题的关键线索。

options.text: Logical connectors help him decide the paragraph order.
options.feedback: 识别逻辑连接词是排列段落顺序的关键。

options.text: The paragraph order is decided randomly without clues.
options.feedback: 排序靠逻辑连接词线索,并非随机。

options.text: Logical connectors should be ignored in this question type.
options.feedback: 原文说连接词正是有用线索,不能忽略。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: I used to spend too much time on one blank, so now I set a time limit for every section.
rounds.lineCn: 我以前总在某个空格上花太多时间,所以现在我为每个部分设定时间限制。

grammar.name: used to + 时态对比
grammar.note: used to 表示过去习惯(花时间太多),now 引出现在的做法(设定时限),形成今昔对比。

options.text: He now sets a time limit for each section.
options.feedback: 他现在的做法是为每个部分设定时间上限。

options.text: He still spends unlimited time on a single blank.
options.feedback: 他过去才这样,现在已设时间限制。

options.text: He gives up the cloze section completely.
options.feedback: 他只是控制时间,并未放弃完形。

rounds.speaker: 学长
rounds.line: Reviewing past mistakes repeatedly is more effective than doing countless new exercises blindly.
rounds.lineCn: 反复复习过去的错题,比盲目地做无数新题更有效。

grammar.name: 动名词短语作比较主语
grammar.note: Reviewing past mistakes 与 doing countless new exercises 两个动名词短语作比较对象,is more effective than 构成比较结构。

options.text: Reviewing old mistakes works better than blind practice.
options.feedback: 复习错题比盲目刷题更有效。

options.text: Doing new exercises blindly is the best strategy.
options.feedback: 原文认为盲目刷题不如复习错题。

options.text: Reviewing mistakes is a waste of revision time.
options.feedback: 原文认为复习错题正是高效方法。
